# application/x-tgif and will not gzip it (1.1 MB on the wire), while
# .txt is text/plain and compresses to roughly a fifth of that.

# www.blender.org
# Texture coordinates stripped: the source .mtl pointed at PBR maps that are not
# shipped here, and materials are assigned per-object in satellite-drag-viz.js.
